propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through production codec and send paths.
Data Center Markdown descriptions and comments must render as native Jira wiki markup through production codec and send paths without echo loops or content erosion.
Echo-safety mechanism (per-binding baseline, normalized outbound, change-gated rich_sha) must suppress unchanged re-emit and detect concurrent edits without data loss.
Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) must survive round-trip through rebar-originated reconciliation without alteration.
DC markdown-to-wiki rendering must handle timeout, missing pandoc, and pathological input with fallback and no content loss.
Comment creation must route through the same rich-text codec as descriptions with append-only local-to-Jira comment-ID mapping.
